# X4 Pro reader panels

This release introduces an X4 Pro-specific reader panel layout while preserving book text rendering and pagination behavior.

## Added

- A dedicated top panel with the clock on the left and a compact battery indicator on the right.
- A bottom reading panel with book progress on the left, the chapter title centered, and the chapter page counter on the right.

## Improved

- EPUB and TXT viewports now reserve space for the X4 Pro top panel so panel content never overlaps book text.
- Page estimation uses the same panel geometry as the reader, keeping progress calculations consistent.
- Existing status-bar visibility, clock-format, battery-percentage, title, page-count, and progress-bar settings remain respected.

## Notes

- Book typography, line breaking, hyphenation, justification, and text rendering are unchanged.
- Other device models retain their existing reader status-bar layout.
- Includes the calendar-based reading statistics introduced in 1.5.0-16.
